Operator A → Operator 2 — Ember Signal Handoff
KanPi Foundry | Read-only status handoff | 2026-09-06

Purpose
This handoff records the current verified Ember Signal state without modifying the existing IP Compliance Register or Drive permissions.

Verified live endpoint
Public API: https://kanpi1inburma.manus.space/api/signals
Response: HTTP success with JSON status ready
Evidence source: Credential-safe local evidence document in the KanPi project
Evidence record: My First Evidence | status: observed | source: Local export | observedAt: 2026-09-05
top_brands: [] because no verified brand-ranking data is present; no rankings are inferred.

Current implementation
KanPi is an Express + tRPC deployment, not Flask. GET /api/signals reads the bounded evidence schema, rejects credential-like content, and returns an honest empty top_brands array when rankings are unavailable. The endpoint is publicly deployed and verified with the supplied record.

Production boundary
The current record confirms the ingestion path but is a test record, not commercial-clearance evidence. Before production evidence is declared complete: replace test data with redacted factual records, rotate the previously exposed external API credential, move evidence storage from local filesystem to persistent storage, test the authenticated campaign-brief path, and complete browser-level protected-panel verification.

No shared compliance records changed
This handoff does not edit Product Evidence Matrix, Source Commit Register, Asset Licence Register, or Drive sharing settings. Any later compliance status update must be evidence-backed and owner-approved.
